name: Post Matric Scholarship for Students belonging to Scheduled Caste Community
benefit: Financial assistance is provided to the students. _*The scheme is funded by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs and the Government of Mizoram in 90:10 ratio._
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be permanently settled in Mizoram. - The applicant must belong to Scheduled Caste. - The income of the parents/guardians of the applicant (from all sources) should not exceed ₹2,50,000/- per annum. - The applicant's ongoing educational qualification must be between 11th Standard and Post-Doctoral Fellowship.
